# ChatBubble

One message in a chat: the AI assistant or Aleem at inline-start, the visitor at inline-end, and quiet system notes centred.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ChatBubble` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ChatBubble>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ChatBubble>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ChatBubble">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

One message in the Aleem chat widget, mascot bubble at inline-start or brand-gradient user bubble at inline-end; mirrors automatically in RTL. Carries delivery status.

| `status` | `'sending' \| 'sent' \| 'failed'` | Delivery state for user messages: sending dims the bubble, failed shows a red edge, "Not sent" and Retry. |

| `failedLabel` | `string` | @default "Not sent" |
